scope: Independent P02 receipt runtime component review only

findings.description: Generated Linux frontend could discard a nonnil exact child returned with a post-spawn error before installing cleanup.
findings.change: Non-nil exact child cleanup registered before error handling; return through defer after spawn.

findings.description: Writer descriptor test lacked immediate owned cleanup before later Fatal assertions.
findings.change: Concrete writer.Close registered immediately after successful ownership admission.

controlsReviewed: Start retains the existing single exact exec.Cmd.Wait; no PID lookup or existing-child adoption was added to production.
Only newly spawned verified installed image receives private write descriptor; binding RuntimeDigest equals that prepared image digest.
Original scope/enrollment digest/actual cold invocation and runtime image digest must all match the one closed frame.
Bounded single read requires four-byte size header, <=4096 total bytes, strict closed JSON, fixed outcome and EOF; repeated reads/writes are refused.
Reader cancellation closes and joins receipt IO without signaling or stopping child. Writer marks CLOEXEC before descendants, bounds its write and closes for EOF.
Exact owned detached child and actual frontend-exit controls passed on Linux; normal no-receipt StartHost remains separate.
Pre-spawn failure closes both pipe ends; post-spawn writer-close failure returns the concrete exact child alongside error rather than dropping ownership.
limits: Transport receipt is not L04 or application status. Accepted emission must be bound to genuine actual operation.enter by root glue.
Runtime scope/digest comparison does not itself verify launcher OwnerEnrollment or actual service lease; root HostPolicy/operation admission supplies those separately.
Linux fixtures are component evidence, not full installed product/Compose/NATS/ten-second acceptance.
Native Darwin execution remains required. No additional system privileges, engine or provider calls were made.
Pattern review sourceDigest is root-owned and remains separately stale; no shared metadata/source edits.
